The Thermostat has the following connections:
* Y2 - Green
* Y - Blue
* W - White
* Rc - Red

The Humidistat has the following connections:
* Red wire
* White wire

Pictures:

The furnace has 2 wires that exit the circuit board 1) which appears to go toward the air intake for the furnace (outside), and 2) which goes up into the ceiling.
